messages:
Freya CS: Noticed a spike in 'owner_unassigned' alerts this week. Sample export shows many accounts have multiple contact records (same person, different emails) and owner is attached to the wrong contact. File: s3://cs/exports/contact_merge_noise.csv
Owen CRM: Yep been seeing this too. Our manual merge flow is slow and causes playbooks to run against the wrong contact. We should canonicalize contacts before ownership and playbooks act.
Lin Data: Quick cluster approach: canonical_contact_key = lower(trim(regexp_replace(email,'\\+.*','')) || '|' || coalesce(sso_id, '') ) . SQL I used to find collisions:
```sql
select canonical_contact_key, array_agg(id) as ids, count(*) as cnt
from contacts
where created_at >= '2024-01-01'
group by 1
order by cnt desc limit 50;
```
Lin Data: Proposal: add `canonical_contact_id` (stable uuid derived from canonical key) and `merge_state` enum {candidate, merged, tombstoned}. Update owner assignment to follow canonical_contact_id.
Harper Ops: Ops concerns: auto-merging is risky for GDPR/history. Plan: 1) non-destructive auto-squash in a staging table, 2) produce a review queue for CS to approve merges, 3) provide an undo tombstone with retention. Also need to preserve activity timeline across merged records.
Freya CS: Important: playbooks should never reassign owner during merge. Owner updates should be a separate step and visible in the review UI. Missed owner changes caused two customers to get duplicate onboarding.
Owen CRM: Agreed. We'll change playbook trigger rules to reference `canonical_contact_id` and add `owner_lock=true` during merge window. Also add a 48h hold before playbooks re-evaluate recently-merged accounts to avoid re-firing.
Lin Data: I'll implement the backfill and a safe-merge job that writes to `contacts_canonical_v1` in staging. We'll expose a preview CSV and small web UI listing diffs. Example backfill cron: `0 3 * * * /jobs/contact-canonical-backfill --src=contacts --dest=contacts_canonical_v1`
Freya CS: UX ask: include a checkbox in the review UI to pull through NPS/feedback items into the canonical timeline so we don't lose prior feedback.
NPSBot: Scheduled: NPS-sync job will join feedback by `coalesce(sso_id, lower(email))` into canonical timeline after merge when reviewer checks the box. Job id: nps-sync-20250726
TicketBot: Created ticket CST-511: "CRM contact canonicalization + safe-merge flow" assigned to Owen CRM, Lin Data, Harper Ops. Priority: P2.
Harper Ops: Rollout plan: 1) run non-destructive backfill and surface top 500 candidates to CS UI, 2) ship playbook changes behind feature flag, 3) run safe merges for approved items, 4) monitor `owner_conflict_rate` and `playbook_retrigger_rate` in Grafana.
Lin Data: I'll add Grafana panels: `cs.owner_conflict_rate` and `cs.canonical_merge_precision` with alerts if precision < 0.9. Backfill ETA: 48 hours.
Freya CS: Thanks. Please add a short blurb in the CS runbook explaining the review UI and owner_lock semantics so SEs don't get surprised. If merge precision causes >5% change in renewal-risk we'll pause and QA heuristics.
Owen CRM: Will post PR and demo to CS channel when ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
